# PresetLauncher

> Free, MIT-licensed Windows application group launcher built with C# and WinUI 3. Create presets and launch multiple programs in one click.

PresetLauncher supports ordered launches, per-program delays and elevation requests, launching missing programs, local history and statistics, JSON preset import and data backup. It does not restore window positions. Consult the download page for available architectures and validation status. Consult the security documentation before importing presets or closing processes.
